report.summary: KILL CRITERION: Parcel zoning unverified with ag-zone prohibition precedent (Solano ZT 12-04 / Ord. 2025-1864) — if Ventura parcels are ag-zoned, local permitting may be impossible; only path is CEC Opt-In, which itself is unconfirmed (storage ≥200 MWh not shown)

findings.title: Parcel zoning unverified — potential ag-zone kill switch
findings.text: site_acres null; no zoning in facts; Ventura zoning unverifiable (search down, vcrma.org 404). KB precedent: Solano ZT 12-04 prohibits commercial solar in ALL ag districts; BESS banned on ag land (Ord. 2025-1864). If Ventura parcels are ag-zoned, local permit may be impossible; path = CEC Opt-In (270-day, preempts local zoning).

findings.title: ITC beginning-of-construction cliff — no BOC evidence
findings.text: OBBBA + Notice 2025-42: solar >1.5 MW forfeits 30% ITC/PTC without physical-work BOC by Jul 4, 2026 (no 5% safe harbor); PIS by Dec 31, 2030 under continuity. Facts have no COD/BOC. ~$43–47M ITC at stake on ~$143–156M PV capex; storage ITC survives. Make BOC proof a condition precedent.

findings.title: Opt-In eligibility unconfirmed — storage ≥200 MWh not shown
findings.text: Storage MW/MWh unspecified. Opt-In requires ≥50 MW solar (met) AND ≥200 MWh storage. If BESS <200 MWh: local route 18–36 mo with denial risk if ag-zoned, plus full EIR (12–24 mo; +1–3 yrs litigated; ~43% plaintiff win rate).

findings.title: No interconnection queue position — CAISO completion ~20%
findings.text: No queue position, cluster phase, POI, or deliverability in facts. CAISO queue >500 GW; ~20% reach COD; IR→COD ~5 yrs; intake capped 150%/zone, scored — Cluster 15 advanced 145/541. Network-upgrade shock = #1 dropout (~30% attrition); transmission +6.1 yrs avg delay. FCDS vs Energy-Only unknown; Energy-Only blocks RA sales.

findings.title: Storage duration unspecified — 4-hr BESS effectively mandatory
findings.text: Storage sizing absent. Standalone solar NQC ~10% (CPUC 2026), ineligible for 6 GW procurement; 4-hr storage = 90–95% NQC. Curtailment 11.5% of potential solar early 2025; battery merchant revenue fell $115→$52/kW-yr (2022→2025) — underwrite to 2025 benchmarks.

recommendedActions: Zoning kill-switch clearance: written Ventura County RMA verification that no parcel prohibits utility-scale solar/BESS, OR a filed and accepted CEC Opt-In application with storage >=200 MWh evidenced.

BOC proof: tax counsel opinion and documentary evidence that the Notice 2025-42 physical work test is met before Jul 4, 2026; no reliance on the 5% safe harbor; failure forfeits ~$43-47M ITC and kills the deal.
Executed offtake: PPA(s) covering >=80% of P50, tenor >= debt plus 2 years, price >= ~$64.49/MWh, RA allocation consistent with Slice-of-Day; LOIs do not satisfy this condition.

Interconnection certainty: CAISO Phase II study in hand with network-upgrade allocation within an agreed cap and FCDS deliverability confirmed; Energy-Only is disqualifying absent a merchant case clearing DSCR.
Site control: executed leases/options for >=570-600 net acres plus gen-tie corridor, clean title, and estoppels for every parcel.
